name: Dispatchers: an OS point that two or more machines take, called for the right machine
description: A part of model27's builder, not a machine (notes/63 §4): compiled once into dispatch.o by tools/gen_parts.py, added by tools/compose.py to a build in which two or more machines take the same vtable entry or hook. The entry or hook goes to the part's dispatcher; the composer writes the data block (each machine's method by machine number) right after the part's code. A point one machine takes keeps that machine's own entry or hook, so SAMPLE alone does not change. The draws and the browser go to the right track's machine, the tick to every machine.
